issues.problem: “経済学と計算、とりわけ A.I.” uses “計算” for “computation,” which is understandable but a little narrower and less natural than the otherwise consistent “コンピュテーション.”
issues.suggestion: Use “経済学とコンピュテーション、とりわけ A.I.” for consistency and technical register.

issues.location: section “How to Spend 10000 Hours of Your Life”, second paragraph
issues.problem: “相当量の配管作業” is a fairly literal rendering of “plenty of plumbing.” It preserves the metaphor but may read slightly stiff in Japanese prose.
issues.suggestion: Consider a more native phrasing such as “地道な仕組みづくり” if polishing manually.

reviews.notes: The translation passes: it preserves the argument, blunt personal tone, humor, and technical structure while reshaping many sentences into natural Japanese rather than following English word order. Human-facing captions, alt text, quotations, and attribution are translated, and glossary-preserved terms such as A.I., MDX context, and product/event names are handled appropriately.

issues.location: 第2セクション「幸福へのリターンを測る」第1段落
issues.problem: “give ourselves a pat on our collective backs” を「みんなで自分たちの背中を叩き」としており、英語イディオムの直訳感が少し残る。
issues.suggestion: 「みんなで自画自賛して」などのほうが自然。

reviews.notes: 全体として日本語の技術エッセイとして自然に読め、英語の語順をなぞる直接翻訳にはなっていない。著者の軽い皮肉、くだけた一人称、A.I. 表記、MDX構造、引用・alt・キャプションの翻訳も保たれている。
